data.mermaidSource:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant W as Web
  participant A as API
  U->>W: Open page
  W->>A: GET /items
  alt cached
    A-->>W: 304
  else fresh
    A-->>W: 200 items
  end
  W-->>U: Render
  Note over W,A: Retries twice
